Lemma: H3884

ENGLISH GLOSSES TO TRANSLATE:
  Terse gloss: "If not, unless, were it not that; a counterfactual conjunction introducing conditions contrary to fact."
  Readable gloss: "A compound particle formed from lu ('if') and the negative le' (a dissimilated form of lo'), lule/lulei introduces hypothetical scenarios that did not actually occur, followed by what would have happened otherwise. Jacob warns Laban: 'unless the God of my father had been with me, you would have sent me away empty' (Gen 31:42). Samson taunts the Philistines: 'unless you had ploughed with my heifer, you would not have found my riddle' (Judg 14:18). The psalmist's broken-off cry in Psalm 27:13 -- 'had I not believed...' -- leaves the terrible alternative unspoken. Arabic lawla preserves the same construction."

  Sense 1: "if not, unless, were it not (counterfactual conjunction)"
    Enriched: A counterfactual conditional conjunction meaning 'if not, unless, were it not that,' introducing hypothetical situations contrary to fact. Key passages include Jacob's warning to Laban (Gen 31:42), the delayed Egypt journey (Gen 43:10), Samson's taunt (Judg 14:18), Abigail's intervention (1 Sam 25:34), and the psalmist's aposiopesis leaving the dire consequence unspoken (Ps 27:13).
    Existing Spanish translations: Si-no, si-no, si-no-fuera-por, si-no-fuera-porque, si-no-fuera-que
